title: Design System: RoR2 Unlocker — Obsidian & ember

headline.purpose: IBM Plex Sans for the application heading.

narrative.overview: A charcoal profile-editing workspace with warm ivory text and ember-orange pending edits. Familiar controls and separate catalog/review work areas preserve the local editing and backup workflows. The header has no edition badge; platform-specific actions and safety instructions communicate the workflow differences.

rules.name: Pending is not complete
rules.body: Ember marks staged progress; green marks existing completed progress. Keep text state labels.

dos: Use Open profile XML as the sole profile opener; keep the loaded path visible.
Keep exact preview before save or download preparation.
Keep platform-specific backup guidance beside final actions.
donts: Do not imitate a fictional HUD.
Do not treat prepared browser downloads as saved source files.
